source.author: cic
source.text: Vna in illa re servitutis oblita civitas ingemuit servientibusque animis, cum omnia metu tenerentur, gemitus tamen populi Romani liber fuit.
source.text_original: Vna in illa re servitutis oblita civitas ingemuit servientibusque animis, cum omnia metu tenerentur, gemitus tamen populi Romani liber fuit.
source.text_english: In that one matter the city, forgetting its servitude, groaned, and though all things were held in fear and men’s spirits were in bondage, the groan of the Roman people was nevertheless free.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: et haec ipsa, quae dixi, periculosa sunt tam loquenti quam audientibus, ut ne gemitus quidem liber sit nolentibus, immo nec audentibus nobis flere, quae patimur.
reuse.text_original: et haec ipsa, quae dixi, periculosa sunt tam loquenti quam audientibus, ut ne gemitus quidem liber sit nolentibus, immo nec audentibus nobis flere, quae patimur.
reuse.text_english: And these very things that I have said are dangerous both to the speaker and to the hearers, so that not even a sigh is free when people do not wish it, indeed, we do not even dare to weep for what we suffer.
